item.itunes:title: 誒！出新款了！啊！不如舊的 - 切玉米神器2026
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU

值得閱讀的理由

  • 影片實測開箱 2026 年最新款的手搖式切玉米神器，直擊其真實操作體驗。
  • 對比新舊款設計，分析「手搖旋轉功能」在實際使用時是否真的省力好用。
  • 提供具參考價值的廚房小工具實用心得，避免盲目購買網購熱門商品。

摘要

博主在影片中開箱了號稱 2026 年新款的「手搖式切玉米神器」。他提到自己這幾年買過多款剝玉米器具，目前心中的優勝者依然是 2022 年購入的舊款 [[00:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=8)]。

新款與舊款最大的差異在於增加了一個「手搖把手」的旋轉功能 [[01:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=75)]。回顧 2022 年的舊款設計，中間的切頭是固定的，使用者需要一手按住玉米、一手手動旋轉玉米來脫粒，實際操作其實相當輕鬆不費力 [[00:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=30)]。

實際開箱與實測心得

博主實際組裝並與妻子一同試用這台新款手搖切玉米器 [[01:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=84)]。然而，在實際操作時，他們發現加入了手搖功能後反而變得更加難用、彆扭，甚至笑稱玉米彷彿「被迫營業」[[00:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=52)]。

實際體驗下來，比起使用手搖桿去轉動，還不如直接按住玉米並往下方推進來得更省力、更直覺 [[00:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=57)]。

最後總結切出來的玉米效果：雖然切出來的玉米粒大致保持完整且表現不錯，但仍有一小部分玉米粒被腰斬切斷 [[01:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=65)]。博主認為這個手搖把手的設計有些多餘，整體評價不如舊款 [[01:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAjv9ys9UFU&t=62)]。

=============

item.title: 中毒了怎麼辦？中毒了去醫院！啊...嘴巴好難受啊... - 龜背竹
item.itunes:title: 中毒了怎麼辦？中毒了去醫院！啊...嘴巴好難受啊... - 龜背竹
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ioctT2Xnkls

值得閱讀的理由

  • 透過親身試吃，呈現大型龜背芋果實從香氣到口感的意外反差。
  • 說明未熟果實中的草酸鈣可能造成口腔刺痛、麻癢等不適。
  • 提醒讀者即使果實完全成熟，也仍可能含有微量草酸鈣結晶。

摘要

作者買下一顆巨大的龜背芋果實，花費超過兩百元，並好奇這種有些地方會種在市區綠帶裡的果實，為什麼價格如此高。果實散發出濃郁香氣，讓作者陶醉其中；成熟的龜背芋果據說帶有鳳梨、香蕉和芒果等熱帶水果氣息，作者則先聞到花香與果香交雜的味道。

聞起來像無花果的氣味，讓作者期待果肉會柔軟飽滿，於是開始試吃。然而入口的味道出乎意料，作者又挑較熟的部位品嘗，同行者也忍不住催促他繼續試。兩人一度擔心吃了會不會中毒，便半開玩笑地說，如果真的不舒服就去醫院。

影片接著解釋，未成熟的果實含有大量草酸鈣，可能讓口腔和喉嚨產生尖銳刺痛感。作者形容味道像百香果或無花果，吃多後卻感到不適；同行者也說嘴巴麻麻辣辣、舌頭發癢，果實表面的鱗片狀結構彷彿刮擦著舌頭和口腔，兩人因此不敢再多吃。

最後，影片提醒即使龜背芋果實完全成熟，仍可能含有微量草酸鈣結晶。這場試吃從迷人的果香開始，卻以口腔麻刺與不適收尾，也讓人明白成熟度和食用安全同樣不可忽視。

================================================

I bought a colossal Monstera fruit. It smells so good, I'm dazed by the fragrance. >> I bought it to try it out. >> In some places, this fruit is actually grown in municipal green belts, so why did they charge me over 200? >> A ripe Monstera deliciosa emits the scents of various tropical fruits like pineapple, banana, and mango. >> I smell a mix of flowers and fruit first. >> Yes. >> That classic fig-like scent suggests that this fruit will taste soft and plump. Come on, have a taste. Wait, what is this? What is this taste? Let me try again. I want to eat from the top, I want to eat the riper part.

>> Alright, alright, I get it, stop nagging. >> What if we get poisoned? >> If we get poisoned, we go to the hospital. >> Unripe fruit contains large amounts of calcium oxalate, which causes a sharp stinging sensation in the mouth and throat. >> Passion fruit? Or fig? Wow, I ate too much, I feel terrible, my mouth is... >> It's numbing and spicy. >> Numbing and spicy, we can't eat any more, we might get poisoned. You take a bite. Does it remind you of any flavor? >> I can't think of it, my mouth is getting a bit itchy. These scale-like things are scraping against our tongues and our mouths. >> However, even when it's fully ripe, it.

will still contain trace amounts of calcium oxalate crystals.

=============

item.title: 那我今天是個80歲的老年人 - 穿針引線小妙招
item.itunes:title: 那我今天是個80歲的老年人 - 穿針引線小妙招
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HE2Po1iQ3kY

值得閱讀的理由

  • 呈現一個據稱能幫助長者穿針的簡易生活妙招。
  • 透過實際測試，檢驗方法是否真的適用，而非只看示範效果。
  • 作者以幽默的反應指出妙招的限制，讓人思考工具是否反而增加麻煩。

摘要

作者提到，自己年紀大了、視力模糊時，或許才會需要穿針妙招；影片接著介紹作者的祖母在八十歲時用過的方法：把線放在紙上，將紙折起來，再剪掉一個角，讓線沿著尖角穿過針眼。

作者準備好針線進行測試，卻發現折起來的紙和線都太厚，紙尖幾乎塞不進針眼。即使使勁推，也只能勉強推入一小截。

有人猜測是紙角不夠尖，於是作者再剪出更小的角度重試，但結果仍不理想。作者認為，折紙後的尖角比針眼還大；若改用較粗的針，穿線本來就不難，因此這個方法並沒有解決問題。最後，作者無奈地表示，還不如直接舔濕線頭再試著穿過針眼。

Cut a corner off, and now the thread is inside that corner, let’s test it. Damn, this is so thick ; never mind the thread, it’s hard enough just to push the paper through,.

okay? Look, I’m pushing as hard as I can, that’s as deep as it goes, only that little bit fits, see? >> Maybe the angle of the paper isn't small enough? We cut a super small angle; this should fit now, right? Let's try again. Did it work? Did it? >> What a load of crap. The folded paper is bigger than the eye of the needle. Maybe some might say a thicker needle would work, but if I’m using a thick needle, I wouldn’t need this trick anyway. >> I might as well just lick it and force it through. Oh, forget it.

item.title: 燒壞我3個打火機！ - 開紅酒妙招2
item.itunes:title: 燒壞我3個打火機！ - 開紅酒妙招2
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cVT0Wl1xeWA

值得閱讀的理由

  • 破解網路生活妙招，驗證「無開瓶器用打火機開紅酒」的真實可行性。
  • 揭示正確加熱位置與操作細節，避免無效加熱與浪費打火機的慘痛教訓。
  • 深入解析氣體熱膨脹推擠軟木塞的科學原理，讓日常技巧背後的知識淺顯易懂。

摘要

網路妙招實測：打火機真能開紅酒？

當手邊沒有紅酒開瓶器時，網路流傳只要用打火機加熱瓶頸，軟木塞便會自動彈出。作者決定親自實測標準軟木塞紅酒，驗證這項技巧是否真如傳言般神準，同時也坦言心中難免擔心玻璃瓶身受熱可能會引發破裂或爆炸的風險。

初次嘗試的挫折與位置調整

在第一次嘗試中，作者直接對著軟木塞所在的位置燒烤，足足加熱了一分鐘卻毫無動靜，瓶頸反而被燻黑且變得滾燙無比。作者重新檢視示範影片後，調整將火焰對準軟木塞底部的空隙。在換了兩支打火機、耗費將近十分鐘的奮戰後，軟木塞終於在氣壓推擠下緩緩上升並成功彈出。

掌握熱膨脹原理，45秒迅速開瓶

為了解答為何初次嘗試耗時甚久，作者進行了第二次測試。這次作者精準固定加熱紅酒液面與軟木塞之間的空氣夾層，結果僅用了45秒便順利將酒塞逼出。作者總結其背後原理在於氣體熱脹冷縮：受熱的密閉空氣體積急遽膨脹，進而產生強大推力頂出軟木塞；直接加熱軟木塞徒勞無功，瞄準空氣腔加熱才是快速成功的關鍵技巧。

================================================

Wow, I can see it moving, wow. >> No wine opener at home? Just heat the bottle neck with a lighter, and the cork will pop out on its own. >> So, for three bottles of standard corked wine, can every single one be opened with just a lighter? It won't explode, will it? Actually, I’m a bit worried it might explode. No, no, no, no. Someone, bring it closer, ouch, ouch. Wow, it takes so long to heat? We've been burning it for a minute, and what do we see? Nothing has changed at all. Look, it’s all burnt black, and.

it feels—damn, it’s super hot. Let me double-check how they did it. >> Heat the bottle neck with a lighter. >> The ad heated this spot here. The base of the cork is here, so we'll heat it right here. My hand is already losing strength, but it’s actually pushing up. It's pushing out more and more clearly. Take this lighter, wow, keep going. Hey, it’s moving. Wow, I see it, wow. Hey, don't.

>> Damn, we spent almost ten minutes in total, burned through two lighters, I'm telling you. >> The cork just popped out on its own. >> It looked so fast when others did it, so why did ours take so long? Let's try one more bottle, don't turn it or touch it, just wait patiently and see if it goes faster. 45 seconds, that was definitely faster. The principle is actually the air gap between the wine and the cork. Heating this air makes it expand, pushing the cork out. That’s why the first bottle failed for so long when we heated the cork directly, but heating the middle on the second bottle made it successful much faster. Yeah.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i9zXi_f_mtg

值得閱讀的理由

  • 作者親自嘗試困在橢圓機上的情況，過程既緊張又滑稽。
  • 旁人一邊擔心作者跌倒，一邊給出令人摸不著頭緒的指示，增添喜劇效果。
  • 作者從堅稱自己不信邪，到最後發現只要調整手的位置就能下來，反轉有趣。

摘要

作者看見有人似乎被困在橢圓機上、無法下來，便決定親自試試。他本來不太情願，還擔心一旦踩空會撞掉牙齒；雖然自稱是華語圈最不相信迷信的人，面對機器隨著腳步移動，仍忍不住緊張起來。

作者試著先把腳放下，卻發現腳一動，橢圓機也跟著移動。他看見周圍聚集了不少人，急忙請對方過來接住自己，擔心自己會摔倒；對方則安慰他，表示會接住他。

在旁人的提醒下，作者開始調整手的位置，但一開始仍不明白究竟哪裡不對。經過一番指點，他終於換了握法，順利從橢圓機上下來，並恍然大悟地說，這一切根本都是假的。

================================================

You have to catch me, what if I fall? >> Seeing someone stuck on the elliptical machine and unable to get down, the host decides to try it himself. >> I don't want to, I don't want to. >> I was just thinking that's how you'd knock your teeth out. >> I want to put my feet down first, but as soon as I move my feet, the machine moves too. >> I don't believe in superstitions; I am the number one skeptic in the Chinese-speaking world. >> Holy crap. There are so many people here, you come over here, you have to catch me, what if I fall? >> I'll catch you in a second. >> I feel like it's no problem. But as soon as I move my feet, the elliptical.

machine moves too. >> Ah, your hands are in the wrong place. >> What's wrong with my hands now? Like this? >> Yes. >> Hey, you're too high up, no. >> Nonsense, I'm telling you, let me try it. You come, you come, you come, you come. Like this? >> And then? Then get down. >> Change your hand position, yes, just change it however, get down. It's fake. It's all, it's all fake.

  • 作者親自嘗試困在橢圓機上的情況，過程既緊張又滑稽。
  • 旁人一邊擔心作者跌倒，一邊給出令人摸不著頭緒的指示，增添喜劇效果。
  • 作者從堅稱自己不信邪，到最後發現只要調整手的位置就能下來，反轉有趣。

摘要

作者看見有人似乎被困在橢圓機上、無法下來，便決定親自試試。他本來不太情願，還擔心一旦踩空會撞掉牙齒；雖然自稱是華語圈最不相信迷信的人，面對機器隨著腳步移動，仍忍不住緊張起來。

作者試著先把腳放下，卻發現腳一動，橢圓機也跟著移動。他看見周圍聚集了不少人，急忙請對方過來接住自己，擔心自己會摔倒；對方則安慰他，表示會接住他。

在旁人的提醒下，作者開始調整手的位置，但一開始仍不明白究竟哪裡不對。經過一番指點，他終於換了握法，順利從橢圓機上下來，並恍然大悟地說，這一切根本都是假的。

================================================

You have to catch me, what if I fall? >> Seeing someone stuck on the elliptical machine and unable to get down, the host decides to try it himself. >> I don't want to, I don't want to. >> I was just thinking that's how you'd knock your teeth out. >> I want to put my feet down first, but as soon as I move my feet, the machine moves too. >> I don't believe in superstitions; I am the number one skeptic in the Chinese-speaking world. >> Holy crap. There are so many people here, you come over here, you have to catch me, what if I fall? >> I'll catch you in a second. >> I feel like it's no problem. But as soon as I move my feet, the elliptical.

machine moves too. >> Ah, your hands are in the wrong place. >> What's wrong with my hands now? Like this? >> Yes. >> Hey, you're too high up, no. >> Nonsense, I'm telling you, let me try it. You come, you come, you come, you come. Like this? >> And then? Then get down. >> Change your hand position, yes, just change it however, get down. It's fake. It's all, it's all fake.

=============
